skill.name: Extend DefaultServerRequestObservationConvention for Custom Metrics
skill.description: Extend DefaultServerRequestObservationConvention to add custom KeyValue pairs to server request observations while preserving default values. Use when migrating from deprecated TagProvider/TagContributor patterns to the new Observation API in Spring Boot 3.0.
skill.skill_body:
Create a custom class extending DefaultServerRequestObservationConvention. Override getLowCardinalityKeyValues() to call super.getLowCardinalityKeyValues(context) and chain .and(custom(context)) to append your custom KeyValue. Define a protected custom() method that returns KeyValue.of("key", value) extracted from the ServerRequestObservationContext. This pattern preserves all default observation tags while injecting your custom metric dimensions.

## Objective

add_custom_observation_tags
## Applicable Signals

- Deprecated TagProvider or TagContributor classes in codebase
- Spring Boot 3.0 upgrade in progress
- Custom metrics required beyond default observation tags
- ServerRequestObservationContext available in handler

## Contraindications

- Fully replacing observation convention (implement ServerRequestObservationConvention directly instead)
- Adding high-cardinality tags that risk metric cardinality explosion
- Overriding metric or trace names (use full convention implementation)
- Removing or filtering default observation tags

## Workflow Steps

- {'step': 1, 'action': 'Create a new class extending DefaultServerRequestObservationConvention', 'detail': 'public class ExtendedServerRequestObservationConvention extends DefaultServerRequestObservationConvention'}
- {'step': 2, 'action': 'Override getLowCardinalityKeyValues() method', 'detail': 'Call super.getLowCardinalityKeyValues(context) and chain .and(custom(context))'}
- {'step': 3, 'action': 'Define protected custom() method', 'detail': 'Extract context data and return KeyValue.of("custom.key", value)'}
- {'step': 4, 'action': 'Register custom convention bean', 'detail': 'Ensure Spring Boot detects and applies the custom convention to RestTemplateBuilder or server request handling'}

## Constraints

- Must extend DefaultServerRequestObservationConvention, not implement from scratch
- Custom KeyValue must be extracted from ServerRequestObservationContext
- Call super.getLowCardinalityKeyValues(context) to preserve defaults
- Use .and() to chain custom KeyValue to default KeyValues

## Cautions

- High-cardinality custom tags can cause metric explosion; validate tag values are bounded
- Ensure custom KeyValue key names do not conflict with default observation keys
- Test that metric and trace names are generated correctly with extended tags

## Output Contract

- Custom KeyValue successfully appended to observation context
- Metric name and trace name generated correctly with extended tags
- Default observation tags preserved and not overridden

## Example Therapist Responses

### Example 1

- Client/Input: Spring Boot 2.x codebase with custom TagContributor adding 'custom.method' tag to metrics
- Therapist/Output: ExtendedServerRequestObservationConvention class that overrides getLowCardinalityKeyValues() to append KeyValue.of("custom.method", context.getCarrier().getMethod())
- Notes: Preserves all default observation tags while injecting custom dimension

### Example 2

- Client/Input: Need to add application-specific request context (e.g., tenant ID) to observations
- Therapist/Output: Custom convention extracting tenant ID from ServerRequestObservationContext and returning KeyValue.of("tenant.id", tenantId)
- Notes: Ensure tenant ID is bounded cardinality to avoid metric explosion
